newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to inject reserves into the banking system through a round of system repurchase agreements on Wednesday, analysts said.
The term is seen anywhere from overnight to six days.
The Fed executed $12 billion, nine-day system RPs on Tuesday.
Federal Funds were under pressure on Wednesday, trading at 5-3/4 percent -- above the 5-1/2 percent target rate.
Analysts noted that Treasury balances at the Fed remain at high levels due to strong tax receipts. Individual tax payments in April are 16.5 percent above last year's strong levels.
